ZIP file reader/writer ported from Go archive/zip structure.

Parses from borrowed spans (central directory + stored entries are zero-copy views into the caller's mapped memory); deflated entries inflate into the caller's reusable Output. Writing streams straight into an Output. Zip64, encryption, data descriptors and multi-disk archives are rejected with a clear error.

Imports

io, flate, crc32

Types

ZipEntry = object
  name*: string              ## slash-separated; dirs end with '/'
  data*: string              ## owned content (deflated entries; "" when span-backed)
  raw*: Span                 ## borrowed content (stored entries, dirs have len 0)
  keep*: RootRef             ## keeps `raw` alive (usually the source Input)
  isDir*: bool
  isSymlink*: bool
  linkTarget*: string        ## valid when isSymlink
  store*: bool               ## force stored (no deflate) even if non-empty
  modTime*: Time
  mode*: int                 ## Unix permission bits, default 0o644/0o755
One file or directory in an archive. 
ZipError = object of CatchableError
ZipReader = object
  files*: seq[ZipEntry]
